#define BITS(N) \ /* <=== libclamav/wwunpack.c:54:73:BITS:1 */ 
bits = bt>>(32-(N)); \
if (bc>=(N)) { \
  bc -= (N); \
  bt<<=(N); \
  if (!bc) { \
    RESEED; \
  } \
} else { \
  if (CLI_ISCONTAINED(compd, szd, ccur, 4)) { \
    bt = cli_readint32(ccur); \
    ccur+=4; \
    bc += 32 - (N); \
    bits |= bt>>(bc); \
    bt <<= (32-bc); \
  } else { \
    cli_dbgmsg("WWPack: Out of bits\n"); \
    error=1; \
  } \
}
